title: Plant Atlas anatomy representation registry
purpose: Separates directly represented 3D anatomy from semantic location anchors and microscopic structures that require reference-scale teaching views.

representationDefinitions.direct-3d: Visible specimen geometry at whole-plant or organ scale.
representationDefinitions.semantic-3d-anchor: Scientifically located 3D inspection target; named tissue may not exist as a separable mesh.
representationDefinitions.micro-reference: Microscopic or internal anatomy whose whole-plant 3D target identifies location/context rather than resolving the structure.

structures.label: Root system
structures.limitation: Represented at whole-plant or organ scale in the specimen; geometry remains illustrative rather than a morphometric botanical scan.

structures.label: Root tips
structures.limitation: The 3D location is a semantic inspection anchor. It indicates the correct anatomical region but does not claim the underlying mesh resolves the named tissue as an independent structure.
